scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 01 most closely preserves source nucleus count while keeping scale, spacing and clustering within the frozen envelope and retaining coherent moderate tumor expansion.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 50,091-pixel joint change forms localized authorized tumor-boundary expansions; its 46,989-pixel tissue component preserves surrounding non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 37 placed nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 1.246, 1.003, 1.031 and 0.922, with local score 0.883.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei occupy authorized expanded tumor; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged.
decisions.limitations: Nuclei are larger than the source reference, though within the frozen gate. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality; another target for this patient has already abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 01 preserves source nucleus count more closely and has a slightly higher local-population score.
Hard gates pass and local score is higher, but candidate 01 has substantially more source-like nuclear scale and count with acceptable spacing and clustering.
